description: The zigordev defaults: a one-day wait, patch and minor updates that merge by themselves on weekdays between 08:00 and 18:00, a major version that waits a month and for a person, our own packages with no wait, and the title fix for an update that changes what a published package ships.

packageRules.description: A patch or a minor update merges by itself once its check is green.
A new major version waits a month, and then for a person.
A new major version of Node.js is a decision for the whole platform, so it is never proposed.
Node.js and its types move together.
pnpm is pinned in mise.toml and in package.json, and both move in one pull request.

The compose files under stack/ are what the package @zigordev/stack ships, so a new image there is titled as a fix. A release is made for a fix or a feature only, and only a release carries the image to a product.

Every image in a compose file that is not our own is pinned by its digest, as name:tag@sha256:<digest>, so that the host runs exactly the image that was checked. Renovate adds the digest where it is missing, and proposes each new one after the day's wait. The owner chose this on 2026-11-24.

The catalog named shipped holds the versions that a published package lists under dependencies, so every product that installs the package gets them. An update there is titled as a fix, so that the package is released with it.

openapi-typescript does not run on TypeScript 7, so the catalog named openapi-typescript keeps TypeScript 5 for the one package that generates the clients. Record 0036 says when that exception goes, and until then Renovate keeps the version below 6.
Our own packages and the pipeline a repo calls arrive at once, in one pull request. This rule stays last, so it also lifts the month a major version waits.
